## listAssets

List Media Assets. `GET /media-gallery`

List gallery assets (excludes archived by default).

Returns the unified {items, pagination} shape. Each item carries BOTH the durable attachment_id and a fresh url. Every filter — archived, favorites_only, media_type, tag and query search — composes with AND and with pagination (e.g. ?archived=only&favorites_only=true = archived favorites).

```php
$sendseven->mediaGallery()->listAssets();
```

- Scopes: `media_gallery:read`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$query` | `?string` | no | Match display_name or description |
| `$tag` | `list<string>\|null` | no | Filter by tag. Repeat the param for multi-tag AND (asset must carry every tag), e.g. ?tag=logo&tag=2024. |
| `$mediaType` | `?string` | no | Filter by media type: image \| video \| document |
| `$favoritesOnly` | `?bool` | no | When true, return only assets marked as favorite. |
| `$archived` | `MediaArchivedFilter\|string\|null` | no | Archive-status view: 'active' (default) = non-archived only (unchanged behavior); 'only' = archived-only (the dedicated Archived tab, for recovering an accidentally-archived asset); 'all' = unified active + archived. |
| `$page` | `?int` | no |  |
| `$pageSize` | `?int` | no |  |

Returns `void`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Media%20Gallery/list_media_assets_api_v1_media_gallery_get)

## createAsset

Create Media Asset. `POST /media-gallery`

Save an already-stored attachment into the gallery.

Re-verifies the attachment belongs to the caller's tenant before insert (never trusts a client-supplied attachment_id); derives media_type/content_type/file_size from the attachment and validates the type/size caps.

```php
$result = $sendseven->mediaGallery()->createAsset(attachmentId: 'attachment_id', displayName: 'display_name');
```

- Scopes: `media_gallery:create`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$attachmentId` | `string` | yes | Id of an attachment the caller's tenant already owns |
| `$displayName` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$description` | `?string` | no |  |
| `$tags` | `list<string>\|null` | no | Tags; normalized to lowercase, trimmed, deduped on save |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `MediaGalleryAsset`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Media%20Gallery/create_media_asset_api_v1_media_gallery_post)

## requestThumbnail

Request Media Thumbnail. `POST /media-gallery/{asset_id}/thumbnail`

Lazily generate a thumbnail for an asset that has none (generate-on-view).

Idempotent and cheap: if the asset already has a thumbnail (or is a document) this just returns it. Otherwise it de-dupes concurrent callers (Redis claim) and enqueues a single background generation job, returning the asset immediately with its current url — the generated thumbnail_url appears on the next list/refresh. Safe for the gallery/picker to call once per visible thumbnail-less card.

```php
$result = $sendseven->mediaGallery()->requestThumbnail(assetId: 'asset_id');
```

- Scopes: `media_gallery:read`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$assetId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `MediaGalleryAsset`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Media%20Gallery/request_media_thumbnail_api_v1_media_gallery__asset_id__thumbnail_post)
